facts.text: Under the Pace Path, every undergraduate receives an individualized educational program connecting academics, one-on-one personal mentorship, and real-world experiences like internships.

sources.title: Your Future: The Pace Path | Pace University New York
sources.quote: The Pace Path gives every undergraduate a more individualized college experience, connecting academics, mentoring, and real-world opportunities to your strengths, interests, and career goals.
